fallingRock.source: src/battle_anim_rock.c:297-333 (AnimFallingRock, AnimFallingRock_Step, both driving TranslateSpriteInEllipse, src/battle_anim_mons.c:516-531)
fallingRock.decoded: Phase 1 (arc down, 16 ticks): sprite.x2 = Sin(circlePos, 0) = 0 always; sprite.y2 = Cos(circlePos, -70); circlePos starts 0, += 4/tick (mod 256) for 16 ticks (0..60) - a quarter-turn arc, y2 sweeping from -70 toward Cos(60,-70). Phase 2 (settle, 32 ticks, starts immediately after phase 1): sprite.x += velocity (one-time step, the createsprite arg), then x2 = Sin(circlePos, velocity) with circlePos restarting at 192 and += 4/tick (mod 256) for 32 ticks, y2 = Cos(circlePos, -24); sprite destroyed when phase 2's duration hits 0. Total per-rock lifetime: 48 ticks from its own createsprite tick (staggered per-rock by the script's own delay-2 spacing, so rocks overlap heavily).
fallingRock.note: Sin/Cos use the engine's standard 256-unit circle (gSineTable); exact per-tick pixel values not hand-derived here - out of scope for extraction, an engine slice reimplements Sin/Cos directly against this formula.

shakeMonOrPlatform.decoded: type=SHAKE_BG_Y targets gBattle_BG3_Y (a background SCROLL register, not BLDALPHA/mosaic). velocity is negated once at setup; every other tick (period = shakeTimer+1, here 2 ticks) the register is offset by +-velocity and the sign flips, for shakeDuration total ticks (here 11), then the register is restored to its pre-effect value and the sprite self-destroys. For ROCK_SLIDE's shake_mon_or_platform velocity=7/shakeTimer=1/shakeDuration=11: gBattle_BG3_Y oscillates +-7 roughly every 2 ticks across an 11-tick window (~5 register writes) then resets.

shakeMon.decoded: Toggles the named battler sprite's x2/y2 between 0 and the given (xOffset,yOffset) every `frameDelay` ticks, `numTimes` times, then restores 0/0 and destroys the task. ROCK_SLIDE calls this with (ANIM_TARGET, 0, 5, 50, 1) - Grovyle's sprite bounces y2 0<->5 every tick for 50 ticks - and (ANIM_DEF_PARTNER, ...), a no-op in this single battle.

hitFlash.source: reference/pokeemerald/data/battle_scripts_1.s:236-261 (BattleScript_EffectHit, the generic damaging-move script ROCK_SLIDE's own BattleScript_EffectFlinchHit :668-670 falls through to via `goto`) issues the `hitanimation BS_TARGET` opcode AFTER attackanimation/waitanimation and BEFORE healthbarupdate - i.e. this fires once the move's own battle_anim_scripts.s script (the falling rocks) has fully finished, not concurrently with it. Cmd_hitanimation (src/battle_script_commands.c:5556-5570) emits BtlController_EmitHitAnimation, handled per-side by e.g. OpponentHandleHitAnimation (src/battle_controller_opponent.c:1804-1816, the Grovyle/opponent-side path relevant here).
hitFlash.decoded: Two concurrent effects on the target: (1) DoHitAnimHealthboxEffect (src/pokeball.c:1284-1291, SpriteCB_HitAnimHealthoxEffect :1294-1306) - the healthbox sprite's y2 toggles +1/-1 every tick, self-destroys after 21 ticks (a small vertical wobble on the HP-bar box). (2) DoHitAnimBlinkSpriteEffect (src/battle_controller_opponent.c:440-455) - the mon sprite's `invisible` flag toggles every 4 ticks, for 32 ticks total (8 toggles = 4 blink cycles), then forces visible and signals done. This is generic to every damaging hit (not ROCK_SLIDE-specific) - the same two effects would fire for any move that reaches `hitanimation` in its battle script.

doubleTeam.decoded: Setup: allocates a scratch palette (reusing tag ANIM_TAG_BENT_SPOON), copies the attacker's own 15 non-transparent palette colors into it, then BlendPalette()s that copy 11/16 of the way toward RGB_BLACK (a darkened afterimage tint) - no new tile graphics, CloneBattlerSpriteWithBlend (src/battle_anim_mons.c:1626-1645) just struct-copies the attacker's existing rendered sprite (Grovyle's own front sprite, already in src/assets/gen/battle-opponent-front-sprites.json) into up to 2 free sprite slots, sets ST_OAM_OBJ_BLEND (so the BG-level BLDALPHA the script set via `setalpha 12,8` actually blends it - see the script's own setalpha step) and makes each visible. Motion (AnimDoubleTeam, called every tick): a sub-counter toggles each call and increments a second counter (data[0], the sine-table index driving both amplitude and phase speed) once every 2 ticks, up to 65; every tick (regardless of the sub-counter), amplitude = gSineTable[data[0]]/6 and phaseSpeed = gSineTable[data[0]]/13 are recomputed from the CURRENT data[0], the running phase (data[1], seeded 0 for the first clone / 128 (half-cycle) for the second - the i<<7 stagger - so the two clones swim out of sync) advances by phaseSpeed and wraps mod 256, and x2 = Sin(phase, amplitude); the clone is destroyed once data[0] exceeds 64 (~130 ticks total motion, since data[0] only advances every 2 ticks). Screen state: DISPCNT's BG1 or BG2 layer (whichever the attacker's sprite BG-priority rank resolves to, GetBattlerSpriteBGPriorityRank) is turned OFF for the whole task's lifetime and restored once both clones are gone - part of how the real sprite vs. its BG-composited copy (from the script's own `monbg` step) avoid double-rendering during the blend.

endeavor.source: data/battle_anim_scripts.s:3789-3803 (Move_ENDEAVOR) - see docs/battle-menu-notes.md §15 for the full oracle-timed derivation, NOT wired into the engine yet (groundwork only, S7 slice E1c)

squish.decoded: Attacker-only affine scale (2-axis, unlike the materialize sequence's uniform affineEmerge - x and y deltas are opposite sign here). Steps (AFFINEANIMCMD_FRAME(dx,dy,rotation,duration), same accumulator semantics as affineEmergeAccumulator): [(-16,+16,0,6), (+16,-16,0,12), (-16,+16,0,6)] starting from neutral (0x100,0x100) - squashes X / stretches Y for 6 ticks, reverses over 12, re-settles over 6 (24 ticks total per cycle). `createvisualtask ... 2` (arg1=numSquishes=2) repeats the WHOLE 24-tick cycle twice (48 ticks total), restarting the accumulator at neutral each cycle (AnimTask_SquishAndSweatDroplets_Step's case 0 re-calls PrepareAffineAnimInTaskData when tNumSquishes hasn't hit 0).

sweatDroplets.decoded: Within EACH 24-tick squish cycle (so 2x total, 8 droplets/cycle = 16 sprites over the full window), CreateSweatDroplets fires twice off the squish task's own local tTimer: tTimer==6 with lowerDroplets=FALSE (xOffset=18,yOffset=-20, upper droplets) and tTimer==18 with lowerDroplets=TRUE (xOffset=30,yOffset=+20, lower droplets) - each call spawns 4 sprites at (baseX-xOffset[-4 for the 2nd]/+xOffset[+4 for the 4th], baseY+yOffset alternating +0/+6), 2 traveling velocX=-2 (leftward) and 2 at velocX=+2 (rightward), all velocY=-1 (drift up), 8x8 un-animated ANIM_TAG_SWEAT_DROP tile. AnimFacadeSweatDrop moves the sprite by (velocX,velocY) every tick and self-destroys once its own local timer exceeds 6 (7 ticks alive: spawn tick + 6 more).

blend.decoded: Attacker-only 16-color palette ramp toward RGB(31,21,0) (a warm yellow) via BlendPalette(paletteId,15,coeff,color) - coeff steps +1/tick (task data[5]=1-tick delay) up to targetCoeff=12 (arg2=12, i.e. 12/16 toward the color), then -1/tick back to 0, repeated numBlends=2 times (arg4=2) - 24 ticks/cycle (12 up + 12 down) x2 = 48 ticks total, same overall length as the squish above (independently driven, not synchronized by a shared clock - coincidence of both scripts using matching-length parameters).

targetShake.decoded: Two separate task instances (one per script `createvisualtask` call, NOT a single repeating task), each `(FALSE, 1, 8, 1, 0)`: arg0=FALSE -> amplitude source is gAnimMovePower (Endeavor's own listed power is 0, the move deals variable HP-diff damage instead - GetMovePower likely returns a nonzero placeholder or 0; NOT RAM-confirmed this session, flagged for the engine slice), clamped to [1,16], then halved into a +up/-down pair (data[14]=amp/2 down-step, data[13]=amp/2 rounded-up up-step). arg1=1 -> step every task-tick-counter > 1, i.e. every 2 ticks. arg2=8 -> 8 alternations before the task restores x2/y2=0 and self-destroys (~16 ticks/instance). arg3=1,arg4=0 -> X-axis (`x2`) shake only, Y branch (`y2`) is gated off (arg4=0) so never executes despite the code path existing. Target = Onix (ANIM_TARGET), the sprite's own x2 offset alternates between +upStep and -downStep every 2 ticks.
targetShake.amplitudeSource: gAnimMovePower/12, clamped [1,16] (RAM-unconfirmed for ENDEAVOR specifically - base power likely 0, needs a dump)

hitSplat.decoded: Two static-position 32x32 sprites (ANIM_TAG_IMPACT, one per script round) at target-relative offsets (12,-12) and (-12,12) (`relative_to=ANIM_TARGET`), each using affine anim index 2 (sAffineAnim_HitSplat_2: instant jump to scale 0xB0 i.e. a zoomed-in/large pop, then AFFINEANIMCMD_FRAME(0,0,0,8) ramps back to neutral 0x100 over 8 ticks) - self-destroys when the affine anim ends (RunStoredCallbackWhenAffineAnimEnds -> DestroyAnimSprite), so each hitsplat is visible ~8-9 ticks total. Round 1 spawns alongside the first targetShake instance; round 2 spawns after `delay 24` (script ticks) alongside the second targetShake instance.
